name: blueprint/video-ascii
description: ASCII video rendering as a share pipeline: ffmpeg renders frames to ASCII, R2 stores the output, a presigned link ships it
recipe: render the ASCII frames (background for long renders) -> exit 0 gates the put -> publish, index, share -> notify the link
pitfalls: long renders belong to rh_run_bg - status only, poll it
the presigned link is a secret for its window
